authorizing_request: User explicitly requests raw net sentiment per actual reporting interval, changes in fund assets, fund fixed effects, end-date/whole-period controls, complete implementation and a new table in the news database.
primary_outcome: 100*(quantity_est/previous_quantity_est-1), previous_quantity_est>0, finite nonnegative valid quantities. Complete-report known exits are -100 percent. Zero-base entries have undefined relative outcome, never infinity.
sentiment: NetSentiment=(N_positive-N_negative)/(N_positive+N_neutral+N_negative), equal relevant deduplicated event representative weights. No residualization, no positive-negative components.
news_window: Moscow publication date > previous actual report date d0 and <= current actual report date d1; monthly and earlier irregular intervals follow actual consecutive reports without EOM restriction.
sentiment_completeness: Primary all expected dated canonical representatives classified validly; at least one relevant item. No news, all irrelevant and any incomplete classification remain missing with distinct states. True balanced/neutral relevant news can have net=0. Missing dates separately audited. Partial95 sensitivity may be stored, not primary regressor.
universe: All available linked corporate portfolio instruments with nonambiguous issuer identity, actual previous/current position observations or certified complete-report absence. Use existing target_security_candidate and preserve source linkage exclusions. All available fund types; explicitly passive flags retained. Do not require full portfolio if own position endpoints observed. Do not expand holdings rows by number of articles.

control_definitions.opening_weight: Previous-report own-position share in gross assets, controls starting position.
control_definitions.closing_log_NAV: Natural log of disclosed positive NAV at interval end.
control_definitions.closing_HHI: All-asset HHI at actual interval end, documented/unallocated buckets included and flagged.
control_definitions.log_news_count_interval: log(1+n_relevant) over the same complete exact window.
control_definitions.log_interval_days: Natural log of positive calendar-day interval duration.
control_definitions.bond_indicator: 1=bond, 0=equity or other admitted corporate security; source class preserved.

estimator: Unweighted native linearmodels PanelOLS entity_effects=True, no time/other effects. If actual duplicate-date compatibility fails use native AbsorbingLS with only categorical fund absorbed and document, no artificial time FE.
covariance: Two-way clustered fund/company, debiased native package settings explicitly recorded; native summary unchanged. Report separate conservative cluster-t inference df=min(number_funds,number_companies)-1, H1 positive one-sided and two-sided CI/p.
hypothesis: H1 in this linear net model: beta_net>0; a single common slope imposes symmetric positive/negative response, not separate asymmetry test.
missing_outliers: Complete-case on fixed declared columns; no winsorization/trimming or imputation chosen from coefficients. Deterministically remove structurally collinear terms with reason, never net signal silently. Record extreme values and singletons.
additional_fixed_outcomes: absolute delta_quantity_est in pieces with same controls/fund FE
delta_share_pp with same controls/fund FE, allowing known zero-base entries where shares defined

database_publication.mode: New versioned additive table plus metadata and indexes; no modifications to articles, FTS, protected databaseresources or live Gemma results. New table publication authorized explicitly by user.

execution: Numeric work and full panel stay on research-host via SSH, scheduled single jobs with PID/checkpoint; small outputs copied to Mac. No new LLM classification.
QA: matching exact windows and aggregation formula
unique fund-security-period rows and no article expansion
no-news vs true zero and classification states
within estimator vs independent small LSDV
native summary numbers vs saved coefficients
SQLite table vs Parquet and existing source preservation
